name: mcp-bridge
description: Foundry VTT Bridge Module for MCP

scripts.package:vtt: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const archiver = require('archiver'); const output = fs.createWriteStream('module.zip'); const archive = archiver('zip', { zlib: { level: 9 } }); archive.pipe(output); archive.file('module.json', { name: 'module.json' }); archive.directory('dist/', 'dist'); archive.finalize();"
